description: Nobody sells this under a name. It's described, when it's described at all, by what people have noticed afterwards, and the noticing is always secondhand, always cheerful, and never complete.

overdose.message: Your whole body cramps at once and you feel drained. It passes, you think.

phases.comedown_message: The heaviness fades, but not all the way.
phases.peak_message: Your gut feels heavy in a way you don't recognise. It doesn't hurt.

effects.take_line: You push the needle in. For a long moment, that's all you feel.

withdrawal.message: The drug's out of you now. You're not rested, just flat.

stages.easing: The temperature settles. The ache stays and stops being interesting.
stages.onset: The heaviness low in your gut lifts, and what's left there isn't empty so much as switched off.
stages.peak: Hot, then cold, then hot, and your whole middle aches on the inside, where there's nothing in there to have hurt.
stages.rising: Your back aches across the kidneys, and the temperature of the room keeps being wrong in both directions.
stages.tail: Back to yourself. Slightly less of yourself than was advertised, and nothing was ever advertised.

name: grey syringe
